elements.content: Enter Sampson and Gregory armed with swords and bucklers.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: Gregory, on my word, we’ll not carry coals.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: No, for then we should be colliers.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: I mean, if we be in choler, we’ll draw.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: Ay, while you live, draw your neck out o’ the collar.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: I strike quickly, being moved.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: But thou art not quickly moved to strike.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: A dog of the house of Montague moves me.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: To move is to stir; and to be valiant is to stand: therefore, if thou art moved, thou runn’st away.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: A dog of that house shall move me to stand. I will take the wall of any man or maid of Montague’s.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: That shows thee a weak slave, for the weakest goes to the wall.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: True, and therefore women, being the weaker vessels, are ever thrust to the wall: therefore I will push Montague’s men from the wall, and thrust his maids to the wall.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: The quarrel is between our masters and us their men.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: ’Tis all one, I will show myself a tyrant: when I have fought with the men I will be civil with the maids, I will cut off their heads.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: The heads of the maids?

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: Ay, the heads of the maids, or their maidenheads; take it in what sense thou wilt.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: They must take it in sense that feel it.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: Me they shall feel while I am able to stand: and ’tis known I am a pretty piece of flesh.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: ’Tis well thou art not fish; if thou hadst, thou hadst been poor John. Draw thy tool; here comes of the house of Montagues.
Enter Abram and Balthasar.

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: My naked weapon is out: quarrel, I will back thee.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: How? Turn thy back and run?

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: Fear me not.

elements.speaker: GREGORY
elements.content: No, marry; I fear thee!

elements.speaker: SAMPSON
elements.content: Let us take the law of our sides; let them begin.
